items.briefing:
Australian CIOs are raising concerns that organisations are rushing to adopt AI without proper governance frameworks in place — a reminder that new technology should always be paired with clear policies on how it's used and who is responsible. Separately, attackers are actively exploiting a patched vulnerability in N-able's remote monitoring and management (RMM) software, which is widely used by IT service providers. If your organisation uses a managed IT provider, it's worth confirming they have applied the latest security updates.

**Practical tip:** Ask your IT provider or helpdesk whether their remote management tools are fully up to date with the latest security patches.

featured.title: Australian CIOs warn AI ambition outpaces governance
featured.quote: AI spending surges while governance lags, creating significant enterprise security risks for Australian organizations.
